cross_container_contract.owner: Portal session (CLAUDE.md 'who builds what'); built over REST after both sides exist
cross_container_contract.rule: Documentation only. Never an automation here and never a target_flow: the portal (CIQ_Supplier_Portal_A00, CIQP flows) is a separate container. Every X also writes a CIQ Audit Event row (category Item created / Notification) per PART D L1288.
cross_container_contract.source: brd.md v4 §4 L289-L301 (authoritative), PART D §5 L1294-L1304 field maps (v4 wins)

items.fires: CIQ Case enters CASE_S1 'Waiting for supplier: basic data' (ItemEntersToStep)
items.data: Request_Key, Case_Code, Cycle_No, Supplier_Code, Supplier_Display_Name ← Supplier_Legal_Name, Trade_Name, Main_INCI, BDF_Material_No, BDF_Contact_Name, BDF_Contact_Email, Markets_Label, Template_Label, Supplier_Due_Date, Case_Contacts_JSON, App_Case_Item_Id ← _id, Assigned_Contacts ← Portal_Contact_Ids

items.fires: Dataform ItemCreated (verified live K-09f); fallback CIQ Sync Service
items.data: section keys, title, applicability, supplier reason, origin, Definition_JSON + hash, due date, app section id ← _id, contacts; no Answers_JSON

items.fires: enters OPNT_S1 'Waiting for supplier', incl. after a Return (K-09h); X3b on ItemSentBack; only when OP_To_Supplier = "Yes"
items.data: Query_Key, Round_No, Question_Text, Supplier_Justification, reference fields, Responsible_Name, Responsible_Department ← Responsible_Dept_Label, Supplier_Due_Date, Previous_Rounds_JSON ← Thread_Text, App_Open_Point_Id ← _id, Assigned_Contacts ← Portal_Contact_Ids
items.condition_note: Action condition on X3 and X3b (PART D L883; COH-03). Internal kinds (Department review, Contact update, Internal review) must never reach the portal (BR-066). ProcessStepBeforeEnter/ItemEntersToStep may fire for skipped steps (v4 L310), so the guard is required even though internal kinds skip OPNT_S1. Hand-off to the portal session.

items.fires: enters CASE_S3 'Waiting for supplier: completeness PS-05'
items.data: Confirmation_Key ← Completeness_Request_Key, Declaration_Text ← Completeness_Declaration_Text, Declaration_Text_Key ← Completeness_Text_Key, Case_Code, Cycle_No, Supplier_Code, App_Case_Item_Id ← _id, Supplier_Due_Date ← Completeness_Due_Date, Assigned_Contacts ← Confirm_Contact_Ids

items.fires: enters CASE_S7 'Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11'; must not fire when CASE_S7 is skipped (overall rejection)
items.data: Confirmation_Key ← Final_Release_Request_Key, Declaration_Text ← Final_Release_Declaration_Text, Declaration_Text_Key ← Final_Release_Text_Key, Case_Code, Cycle_No, Supplier_Code, App_Case_Item_Id ← _id, Supplier_Due_Date ← Final_Release_Due_Date (if set), Assigned_Contacts ← Confirm_Contact_Ids
Notice_Key, Notice_Kind, Case_Code, Cycle_No, Supplier_Code, App_Notice_Item_Id ← _id, Notice_Title, Notice_Text ← Supplier_Outcome_Text, Related_Key ← CR_Key, Assigned_Contacts ← Portal_Contact_Ids

items.fires: basic data submitted (CIQP Request ItemCompleted); only while Basic_Data_Received is blank
items.data: Basic_Data_Received ← 'Yes', Portal_Request_Item_Id ← _id; then Process 'Approve an item' on CASE_S1
items.status: unverified, K-09b/c/g; approve action unverified (open-questions Q6)

items.data: Response_Kind, Response_Text, Response_Doc_Refs_JSON, Supplier_Responsible_Email, Portal_Query_Item_Id ← _id, Awaiting_Response ← 'No'; then approve OPNT_S1

items.fires: supplier confirmed (ItemCompleted); only while Completeness_At is blank
items.data: Completeness_Confirm ← Supplier_Confirm, Completeness_By_Name/_By_Email/_By_Role ← Confirmed_By_*, Completeness_At and RMES_Created_At ← Confirmed_At; then approve CASE_S3

items.fires: supplier released (ItemCompleted); only while Completion_Trigger is blank
items.data: Final_Release_Confirm ← Supplier_Confirm, Final_Release_By_*/_At ← Confirmed_*, Released_Revs_JSON, Evidence_List_Text, Completion_Trigger ← 'Supplier final release'; then approve CASE_S7
change fields 1:1, Portal_CR_Item_Id ← _id, Raised_By_Portal_User ← _created_by; CreateAndSubmit (Start has no Mandatory fields, D16)

content.name: CIQ Z2 Case cancelled – neutral e-mail

action.message: Neutral literal text: the CIQ request for this material has been closed by Beiersdorf. No action is needed. (Final wording by BDF.)

content.self_stitch_note: AUTO_SELF warning is expected: the e-mail reads Notify_Recipient from the triggering Cancellation row and writes no record, so there is no loop.
rest_completion: Trigger: Dataform ItemCreated on CIQ Audit Event; action condition Event_Category = "Cancellation".
Action: e-mail Notify_Recipient with the neutral literal. No audit action here, so no loop with Z1/Z3/Z4 (PART D L1306).
If the action condition (K-09g) fails, do not build it: the CIQ Sync Service sends the e-mail during the close sweep.
